assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One production fantasy game interface corner fitting, square image, front-facing orthographic. The whole background is perfectly flat pure magenta #FF00FF with no shading, no gradient and no cast shadows (it will be keyed out to transparency). A TOP LEFT corner bracket in the style of the brass hardware on a well-loved tavern chest. At the corner, a generous square block of warm polished honey oak with a carved eight-petal rosette, capped by a thick hand-hammered amber-brass corner plate with softly scalloped edges and four large domed brass pins. From the plate, two hammered brass strap-hinge arms run along the TOP edge and the LEFT edge only, each laid over a narrow strip of the same honey oak with a carved bead-and-reel edge. Each brass strap narrows gently along its length, is fastened by three smaller domed pins, and ends in a decorative spade-shaped (fleur) finial, like a blacksmith-made strap hinge. Welcoming artisan craftsmanship, visible hammer dimples, warm lamplight highlights on the brass, fine oak grain. Rich hand-painted realistic strategy-game UI art, sculpted volume, restrained highlights. IMPORTANT composition: the corner block and plate occupy the top-left 38 percent square. The top arm stays within the top 13 percent of the image and the left arm within the left 13 percent. Both arms end with their finial before the right edge and the bottom edge, leaving a small magenta margin. The entire lower-right 60 percent square must be completely flat magenta and EMPTY for interface content. Inner corner squared, nothing protruding toward the centre. No right or bottom border. Do not use magenta, pink or purple anywhere in the fitting itself. No leaves, no ivy, no stone, no scenery, no text, no letters, no frame around the entire image, no shadow on the background. This is a practical small detailed corner asset, not an illustration of a room.
